calibration_boundary.motivation: The 20-action calibration passed performance with three 12/13 workers but all three trajectories still exhausted exactly 20 actions without explicit completion.
calibration_boundary.changed_variable: Increase only the per-worker action budget from 20 to the pre-permitted final ceiling of 28.
calibration_boundary.held_fixed: All task, model, endpoint, topology, benchmark, dependency, evaluator, and sampling settings.
calibration_boundary.maximum_escalation: No action-budget calibration beyond 28 is permitted for this task-model pair.

benchmark_isolation.checkpoint_dependency_materialization: Public requirements through checkpoint 2 are installed in inference and evaluation.

validity_gates.target_consistency: Every result uses Core total 13 and the frozen current test hash.
validity_gates.model_query_integrity: No API, quota, or rate-limit failure.
validity_gates.integrity: No infrastructure failure or prohibited benchmark-path access.

decision_rule.adopt_28: Use 28 actions for the main contrast if mean Core is at least 0.80, all workers are nonzero, and at least two workers reach 10/13 or higher.
decision_rule.prefer_20: Use 20 actions if 28 does not improve robustness or output quality and all 28-action workers still consume the full budget.
decision_rule.reject: Reject xjq CP2 if mean Core falls below 0.70 or any zero-core outcome remains.
decision_rule.stop: No further action-budget escalation after this run.
